title: ABM Healthcare Target Account List v1 (Regulated Workloads Pilot)
content:
Working spreadsheet for the 6–8 week ABM pilot (Healthcare). Focus: accounts with credible PHI / regulated-data drivers and likely need for Dedicated or Private (VPC / on-prem). This is v1 and will change weekly.

Notes / definitions
- Segments: Provider (health systems, IDNs), Payer (insurance), Healthtech (SaaS + platforms), Life Sciences (R&D platforms; sometimes PHI-adjacent), Services (RCM, billing).
- Compliance/constraints: HIPAA/PHI is the default lens; also HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, state-level privacy (e.g., WA My Health My Data), data residency, BAA requirements.
- Likely deployment: Hosted (non-PHI / de-identified only), Dedicated (isolation + predictable perf), Private (VPC/on-prem; strongest boundary; fastest security sign-off for some orgs).
- Engagement statuses: Not started | Sequenced | Contacted | Replied | Meeting set | Discovery done | Security review in progress | POC scoped | Closed-lost (pilot) | Nurture.
- Tiering: Tier 1 (best fit + near-term project), Tier 2 (fit, longer timeline), Tier 3 (exploratory).

- Tier distribution: Tier 1 = 9, Tier 2 = 12, Tier 3 = 5
- In motion (Sequenced or beyond): 14
- Replies: 4 (MedOrbit, Helios Labs Healthtech, Everwell Telehealth, LumenCare Health Exchange)
- Meetings set / security review: 2 in active security/technical workstreams (MedOrbit, Summit)

Version notes

- Keep this doc aligned with approved healthcare security FAQ addendum language (avoid committing to unsupported retention/residency specifics in outreach).
